fields.label: Cities or regions for the first weeks

en.template: Help me plan a New Zealand working holiday from {country} for {people} people starting around {start}. We are aged {ages}, have {savings} and plan to work in {work}. Check the opening date and quota, whether each of us needs our own application, the fees and the funds rule, then rebuild the pay example and the runway table with my own flight price, rent and hours. Compare {cities} for the first weeks, and mark anything unconfirmed. Ask before contacting anyone or paying anything.

phases.title: Read the official visa, wage, tax and rental pages and gather dated room-rent examples and the seasonal work calendar
phases.note: Visa rules and fees, pay and tax example, rents in four cities, harvest timing
phases.judgment: When an official source could not be reached it said so: the Reserve Bank’s exchange-rate page returned an error, so the rate of 0.55434 US dollars per NZ dollar (6 November 2026) comes from a data service and is labelled as secondary. It also noted that Wellington’s room median rests on only 21 rental bonds.

phases.title: Write the guide, the source list and the calculation scripts
Recompute every money figure, check the claims against the source list and test the page on desktop and phone
phases.judgment: The final check passed on the recomputed money figures, and the guide still lists what it could not confirm: the 2027 opening date, whether the NZ$4,200 funds proof is per person, and that the plan is about USD 741 short if that proof must stay in the account.

workers: Collected dated room-rent examples in four cities and the month-by-month seasonal work calendar
Looked up exchange rates, health-insurance cover, the tax number and bank steps, tax rates and a worked weekly pay example
